questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of metals?
choices: They are poor conductors of electricity
They react with oxygen to form acidic oxides
questions.solution: Metals are generally malleable and ductile, which means they can be beaten into shapes and drawn into wires. The other options are incorrect because metals are usually lustrous, good conductors of electricity, and react with oxygen to form basic oxides.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a non-metal based on its properties?
choices: A metal that is malleable and ductile
A substance that is a good conductor of electricity
A material that is soft, dull, and a poor conductor of heat
A substance that forms a basic oxide
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A material that is soft, dull, and a poor conductor of heat' because non-metals typically have these characteristics. Metals are malleable, ductile, and good conductors, so the first two options are incorrect. Non-metals form acidic oxides, not basic ones, so the last option is also incorrect.

questions.stem: What does the presence of brown deposits on an iron nail indicate?
choices: It is a sign of corrosion
It is a sign of purity
It is a sign of being metallic
It is a sign of being a good conductor
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'It is a sign of corrosion' because brown deposits on an iron nail are rust, which is a form of corrosion. Corrosion is the gradual deterioration of metal surfaces due to air, water, or other substances. The other options do not accurately describe what the brown deposits indicate.

hi.stem: लोहे की कील पर भूरे निक्षेप की उपस्थिति क्या संकेत देती है?

questions.stem: Which of the following materials would produce a ringing sound when dropped on the floor?
questions.solution: Copper is a metal, and metals typically produce a ringing sound when dropped due to their ability to vibrate and produce sound waves, a property known as sonority. Coal, wood, and sulfur are not metals and do not exhibit this property. Therefore, copper would produce a ringing sound when dropped on the floor.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित सामग्रियों में से कौन-सी ध्वनि उत्पन्न करेगी जब इसे फर्श पर गिराया जाए?

questions.stem: Which of the following metals reacts vigorously with water?
questions.solution: Sodium is a highly reactive metal that reacts vigorously with water, producing hydrogen gas and heat. This reaction can be dangerous. Copper, aluminium, and zinc do not react as vigorously with water.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a poor conductor of electricity, as observed in Activity 4.4?
questions.solution: Sulfur is a poor conductor of electricity because it does not allow electric current to pass through it, which can be observed when it fails to complete an electrical circuit. Copper, aluminum, and iron are all metals, which have free electrons that enable them to conduct electricity efficiently. Non-metals like sulfur lack these free electrons, making them poor conductors.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन विद्युत का खराब चालक है, जैसा कि गतिविधि 4.4 में देखा गया है?
hi.solution: सल्फर विद्युत का खराब चालक है क्योंकि यह विद्युत धारा के पार जाने की अनुमति नहीं देता है, जिसे जब यह विद्युत परिपथ को पूरा नहीं करता है, तब देखा जा सकता है। तांबा, एल्यूमीनियम और लोहा सभी धातुएं हैं, जिनमें मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं जो उन्हें विद्युत के द्वारा अच्छी तरह से चालन की अनुमति देते हैं। अधातु जैसे सल्फर में इन मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉन नहीं होते हैं, जिसके कारण वे खराब चालक होते हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a metal that is both malleable and ductile?

questions.stem: Which of the following metals is used in making electrical wiring?
questions.solution: Copper is used in making electrical wiring because it is an excellent conductor of electricity. Unlike iron, aluminium, and gold, copper allows electric current to flow with minimal resistance, making it ideal for this purpose. While aluminium is also a conductor, copper is more commonly used due to its superior conductivity and durability.

questions.stem: An electrician uses a screwdriver with a plastic handle and wears rubber gloves. What is the reason for this?

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a non-metal that is stored in water?

questions.stem: Why is sodium not suitable for use in making objects that are exposed to water?
choices: It is highly reactive with water
It is a poor conductor of electricity
questions.solution: Sodium is highly reactive with water, which means it would undergo a dangerous chemical reaction when exposed to it, making it unsuitable for such use. Non-metals are not relevant here, as sodium is a metal. Lustrous or non-lustrous properties do not affect its suitability in water, and sodium is actually a good conductor of electricity, so that is not the reason either.
